What is included in a sound system rental?
A full system sized to the space: speakers, subwoofers, a mixer, microphones, cabling and an engineer to run it. For just a pair of speakers, see speaker rental.
Does a sound system rental come with an engineer?
Yes. We set it up and check it, and an engineer can stay to mix the show.
Do you rent sound equipment for conferences?
Yes. Podium and lavalier mics, a mixer, speakers for the room and a feed for the stream or recording, run by an engineer.
Yes. We rent and sell directional speakers for exhibitions, stores and installs where the sound has to stay in one spot.
Yes. Background and zoned audio for stores, lobbies, offices and homes, installed and handed over.
